subject: Update of the bundled Bootstrap version

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Update of the bundled Bootstrap version
parts:
Is there any plan to update the currently bundled version of bootstrap in shiny? From what I can find it is v2.3.2 at the moment while the current bootstrap release is v3.1.1

I don't expect shiny to be updated with every small release of bootstrap, but just the major ones : ) For developers of shiny extensions it would be nice if we didn't have to include our own bootstrap css for it to work, as this could lead to redundancy in apps that use multiple shiny extensions...

best

Thomas

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Update of the bundled Bootstrap version
parts:
Yes, it is on our plan, but there is not ETA at the moment. The
current plan is to do it after we release the next version (0.10).

Regards,
Yihui
